page_title: BAR 5-1 SEV | Barcelona v Sevilla 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Pablo Torre (Barcelona) goes wild in celebration.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.

90' The Barcelona players halt their celebrations as referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
88' 5 - 1 Pablo Torre (Barcelona) sets up the ball for the free kick and sends a sweet accurate shot into the bottom right corner. A simply glorious goal!
88' Loic Bade (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
87' 4 - 1 Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
85' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
83' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Pedri and he is replaced by Gavi (Barcelona).
82' 4 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Pablo Torre (Barcelona) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Orjan Nyland. He makes it 4:0.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gonzalo Montiel (Sevilla) is coming onto the pitch as Adria Pedrosa cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Djibril Sow (Sevilla) and blew his whistle. Barcelona are awarded the free kick.
77' The attendance for today's match is 47848.
76' It's time for a substitution. Gerard Martin (Barcelona) comes on in place of Ansu Fati.
76' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Pablo Torre (Barcelona) replaces Lamine Yamal.
74' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Ansu Fati (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
72' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) has a goal ruled out for offside!
70' Substitution. Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lucien Agoume walks off.
70' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta is forced to make a change. Suso (Sevilla) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Djibril Sow.
69' The game is interrupted now, Suso (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
66' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Raphinha is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Lewandowski leaves the pitch and Pau Victor (Barcelona) comes on.
63' Sevilla force a corner. They send men into the box.
63' Suso (Sevilla) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
60' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
60' Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
60' One of the Sevilla players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
59' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
58' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! There is a free kick near the sideline to Barcelona.
56' Wonderful movement by Barcelona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
55' Sevilla control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
53' Sevilla concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Barcelona have a free kick.
52' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
52' The corner from Pedri (Barcelona) is intercepted by Orjan Nyland.

51' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla. Raphinha (Barcelona) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
49' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Raphinha (Barcelona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
48' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

47' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the top right corner, but Orjan Nyland easily deals with the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Barcelona will have a corner.
47' Pedri (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

47' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Suso (Sevilla) comes on the pitch for Peque.
46' The whistle blows and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

45+3' A player from Barcelona commits a rough challenge. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Sevilla will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
45+2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
45+1' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) is substituted due to injury. Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives a chance to Albert Sambi Lokonga.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
43' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
39' 3 - 0 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 3:0.
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Barcelona comes to nothing.
36' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Orjan Nyland.

34' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Barcelona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
33' Handball! A player from Sevilla handled the ball. Barcelona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
33' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.

28' 2 - 0 Pedri (Barcelona) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Lamine Yamal. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the top right corner via the woodwork. 2:0!
24' 1 - 0 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Orjan Nyland to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
23' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
23' Peque (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a set piece. PENALTY! One of the players from Barcelona is about to take a penalty kick.
21' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Sevilla earn a corner.
20' Marcao (Sevilla) takes the corner but it's cleared.

19' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.

17' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
15' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.

14' Loic Bade (Sevilla) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea with no other option than to blow for a foul. Barcelona are awarded a free kick.
14' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

13' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Barcelona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
11' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
7' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
7' The Barcelona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' The ball is cleared after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

5' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
3' It's a throw-in for Sevilla.
2' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will officiate today.
